limitations: Metering is real CPU time: fresh runs in different processes agree only up to measurement noise; the deterministic memo makes forks and reruns exact within a process and lets a stateful program hide up to 3x + 1 ms of repeated identical work (KNOWN_OPEN low).
Work-unit scale (350 ns per unit) is calibrated on the reference need solvers on this host; C-heavy code now costs its real CPU (it was free under the line model).
Package adoption by ablation cannot tell output that depends on reading the package's files from real use (KNOWN_OPEN medium); a per-dependency RPC boundary would.
Engagement integrity is state-based: colluding agents with distinct controllers, own funding and a token footprint pass as organic (KNOWN_OPEN medium).

Chromium runs with --no-sandbox inside the jail (no user namespaces or setuid helper in this container); browser mode for the agent browser allows IPv4 TCP connect to the world app's port on any address (Landlock rules are per port, not per address); abstract AF_UNIX sockets are not scoped (Landlock ABI 4).
Process-level isolation only (shared kernel); no VM-grade backend available on this host.
Gate W tests assert the manifest criteria as written; W.2, W.3, W.4 and W.7 fail until the owners close the KNOWN_OPEN entries.
